provenance.temporal_resolution: daily (accumulated from half-hourly IMERG Early; UTC day)
processing: OPeNDAP subsets of daily `precipitation` (mm/day, UTC days) from GPM_3IMERGDE V07; granule versions: V07B 2026-01-20..2026-03-03; V07C 2026-03-04..2026-03-05
placed on the 30 m farm grid by nearest: each 30 m cell takes the 0.1 degree cell containing it; coarse value kept coarse
one band per day; a day without a granule is a NaN band
provenance.notes: Local (farm) daily rain. Missing days: none. Catchment-mean upstream rain: processed/rain/imerg_catchment_daily.csv.
